exposure: uterine extension at the time of cesarean
outcome: Composite maternal morbidity (blood transfusion, endometritis, readmission)
cohort: Women undergoing a primary low transverse cesarean section for a full-term singleton gestation
finding: Women with uterine extensions during cesarean section had higher estimated blood loss, increased risk of composite maternal morbidity, postpartum hemorrhage, and longer hospital stays.
mod_finding: Uterine extensions during cesarean delivery are associated with adverse maternal outcomes, including higher estimated blood loss and increased maternal morbidity.
